statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ is weekend-closed, so current Tail remains low despite extreme geopolitical and energy-supply Stress.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. Risk is concentrated at the scheduled Globex reopening, where gap persistence, pullback depth and current cross-asset alignment become observable.
headline: Energy-route disruption keeps Stress extreme before NQ reopens
body: NQ remains closed for the weekend, leaving no live Nasdaq price-path evidence of persistent mean-reversion failure. Reuters reports severe Saudi East-West pipeline disruption, a new Hormuz vessel strike and weaker Saudi equities; these raise gap, inflation and yield risk into the reopen.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding UTC clock hours have published ChatGPT assessments. Tail stayed at 19%; Stress was 99% through 02:00 UTC and 100% from 03:00 UTC onward, while Confidence remained 98% and dominantMode stayed normal.
outlookSummary: Conditional risk is concentrated at the Sunday Globex reopening and early price discovery. A gap that develops two-way trade or meaningful retracements supports low Tail; repeated extension, shallow pullbacks and aligned current cross-assets would justify escalation.

forecast.analysis: NQ is weekend-closed, so no live Nasdaq price path can confirm persistent mean-reversion failure. Saudi pipeline, Hormuz and Gulf-equity stress keep the macro backdrop extreme.
drivers: NQ closed; no live price-path evidence

forecast.analysis: If the backdrop is unchanged while NQ remains closed, the next hour is a headline-sensitive gap-risk period. Tail stays low because directional persistence and retracement quality cannot yet be observed.
Pre-Globex uncertainty remains concentrated in the possible opening gap. A future gap would not by itself establish Tail; persistence after the reopen would be the relevant test.
drivers: Oil and rates are reopening checkpoints

forecast.analysis: Three hours before the scheduled reopen, Stress remains extreme while Tail stays low. The adverse future path would require a gap followed by shallow pullbacks or repeated extension.
drivers: Three hours to scheduled Globex reopen

forecast.analysis: If the backdrop remains unresolved two hours before the scheduled reopen, risk stays event-driven rather than price-path confirmed. The first meaningful test will be whether any opening impulse retraces.
drivers: Two hours to scheduled Globex reopen

forecast.analysis: One hour before the scheduled reopen, Tail remains below WATCH because the future NQ path is still unobserved. Gap size, pullback depth and cross-asset alignment are the next checkpoints.
drivers: One hour to scheduled Globex reopen

forecast.analysis: At the scheduled Globex reopen, conditional Tail peaks at 24% WATCH. A sustained gap with shallow pullbacks and aligned oil, yields and volatility would be the path that could justify a higher band.

news.title: Saudi pipeline outage threatens loss of 4% of global oil supply
New attacks in Hormuz and Saudi test nerves as war's spread worsens oil disruption

forecast.analysis: During the first post-reopen hour, WATCH remains conditional on how price discovery develops. Two-way trade and meaningful retracements would argue against escalation; repeated extension would raise concern.

news.title: Saudi shares drop after pipeline attack, leading Gulf decline

forecast.analysis: In the second post-reopen hour, conditional Tail eases slightly if the opening impulse is no longer extending efficiently. Failure to retrace would keep the path near the top of WATCH.
By the third post-reopen hour, conditional Tail falls toward the lower WATCH band if price discovery becomes more balanced. Continued one-way extension would invalidate that easing path.
Conditional Tail returns to low only if the early overnight session shows two-way trade or meaningful retracement. Persistent directional efficiency would keep risk above this baseline.
Later overnight risk can ease further if volatility decays and the initial geopolitical gap impulse is absorbed. A fresh energy escalation or failed retracement would reverse that easing.
The Asian-session handoff is conditionally lower Tail if NQ has developed balanced trade. Oil and rates remain important conflict checks because the supply shock is unresolved.
drivers: Oil and rates remain conflict checks

forecast.analysis: As Asia progresses, low Tail assumes no renewed directional extension. Persistent holding near an overnight extreme with shallow pullbacks would be evidence against this forecast path.
Approaching Europe, conditional Tail remains low if overnight price discovery is orderly. A fresh geopolitical discontinuity could reprice the opening distribution even without scheduled U.S. data.
At the European handoff, the low-Tail path assumes retracements remain available and cross-assets are not aligning into a one-way Nasdaq move.
During early Europe, Tail stays low conditionally if any overnight move is being absorbed rather than repeatedly extended. Energy and yields remain the main macro transmission channels.
Mid-European trading remains a conditional low-Tail window if volatility is contained and NQ is not pinned near an extreme. The geopolitical backdrop keeps Stress elevated.

Late European morning keeps a low conditional Tail baseline if price action remains two-way. A renewed oil shock or yield surge would raise Stress first unless NQ also becomes directionally persistent.
drivers: Oil shock remains a Stress driver
Yield surge needs NQ confirmation for Tail

forecast.analysis: Before U.S. participation increases, Tail remains low conditionally if overnight structure has not become one-way. Liquidity transition can widen moves without proving mean-reversion failure.
drivers: Large move alone does not establish Tail

forecast.analysis: As U.S. participation builds, conditional Tail edges back to 19%. Overnight gap retention, yields and semiconductor or megacap breadth become more informative ahead of the cash open.
The hour before the U.S. cash open is a high-Stress checkpoint. Tail stays below WATCH unless overnight direction is already persistent and current cross-assets confirm continuation.
drivers: One hour before U.S. cash open

forecast.analysis: During the U.S. cash-open hour, conditional Tail remains 19% unless the opening auction produces persistent extension, shallow pullbacks and aligned current cross-asset confirmation.
In the first post-cash-open hour, the low-Tail path assumes the opening move either retraces meaningfully or becomes two-way. Continued extension after failed pullbacks would be the key invalidation.

forecastDetail.comment: NQ is closed; extreme energy and geopolitical Stress is not current evidence of a persistent Nasdaq price path.
Closed-market gap risk remains high, while directional persistence and retracement quality remain unobservable.
A future opening gap is a checkpoint, not proof of mean-reversion failure; persistence after reopening is decisive.
Stress is extreme before Globex, but Tail remains low until the future opening path provides directional evidence.
The first meaningful future test is whether any reopening impulse retraces rather than repeatedly extends.
Immediately before Globex, gap size, pullback depth and cross-asset alignment remain future checkpoints.
